hypotheses: Primary cause: the ingestion-worker was temporarily stopped while six normal documents were submitted through POST /documents, leaving their normal ARQ ingestion jobs pending.
Supporting telemetry: insighthub_arq_queue_depth was 6 at 2026-09-25T04:35:26.208Z and exceeded the one-hour statistical upper band while InsightHubARQQueueBacklog fired.
Impact: the six submitted documents remained pending until worker recovery; no direct Redis writes or manual ARQ-key changes were used.
Recovery: the worker was restarted, drained the queue normally, and documents 199 through 204 all reached ready with one chunk and no error code.
observed_symptom: The ARQ ingestion queue remained non-empty and the queue-backlog anomaly fired.
primary_cause: The ingestion-worker was stopped while normal API ingestion requests continued to enqueue jobs.
impact: Six normal ingestion jobs waited in ARQ and their documents remained pending until the worker returned.
recovery_action: Restarted the existing ingestion-worker and allowed normal ARQ processing to drain the queue; all six documents became ready.
evidence_limitations: The start timestamp is the first recorded high-depth Prometheus sample; the worker-stop command itself was not independently timestamped in the report.
